flags.evidence_quote: BE IT RESOLVED that a special assessment of $8,500 per unit ($714,000 in total) be levied, payable in four quarterly installments of $2,125 commencing July 1, 2026.
The reserve fund balance at year-end was $745,000 against a study-recommended balance of $1,221,000 — approximately 61% funded.
The preliminary opinion of probable cost is $1,150,000, which is not currently funded in the reserve fund plan.
The window water-ingress claim affecting units 304, 305 and 406 remains in mediation; the next session is scheduled for October 28, 2026.
The deductible has increased to $100,000 per occurrence following the June 2024 hail claim ($380,000 paid).
The Board reviewed a draft amendment that would cap rentals at 15% of units (22% of units are currently rented).
Unit 1204: fourth noise complaint in six months (late-night music). The Board authorized a final warning letter; fines under section 12.4 of the bylaws will apply to any recurrence.
